treatment_plan.definitive: Trial of marrow-preserving and post-filling treatment
treatment_plan.notes: Pay attention to oral hygiene and return to the clinic regularly.

source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine was used to remove caries and prepare the hole. Upper molding piece. Clean and blow dry, place LC bottom near the marrow. Etch with acid etchant, rinse and blow dry. Apply adhesive, blow thin, and illuminate. 3M-P60 resin is filled in layers and light-cured in layers for shaping, jaw adjustment and polishing.
